question: By whose grace does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker claims to be known or to have come to know.
That knowledge comes by the grace of the addressed lord.
The object known is the determination of the Kaula teaching.
inference: By the grace of the lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
uncertainties: Nuance between jñāta as known and made known remains open
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
